text.EN: I'm pretty hungry, if I'm honest. Do you have anything to eat?
text.TL: Medyo gutom ako, kung tutuusin. May makakain ka ba?

text.EN: My stomach has been growling for hours. Got any food to spare?
text.TL: Kanina pa kumakalam ang sikmura ko. May maibibigay ka bang pagkain?

text.EN: Really feeling the hunger right now. Could use a bite.
text.TL: Ramdam na ramdam ko ang gutom ngayon. Kailangan ko ng makakain.

text.EN: Haven't had a proper meal in a while. Any rations on you?
text.TL: Medyo matagal na mula noong huli akong kumain. May rasyon ka ba?

text.EN: Need some calories before my strength fades. Got anything?
text.TL: Kailangan ko ng lakas bago ako manghina. Mayroon ka ba riyan?

text.EN: I'm starving out here. Even stale crackers would do.
text.TL: Gutom na gutom na ako rito. Kahit lumang biskwit tatanggapin ko.

text.EN: Food is getting urgent for me. Anything in your pack?
text.TL: Kailangan ko na talagang kumain. May laman ba ang bag mo?

text.EN: Hard to focus when your stomach is this empty. Spare any food?
text.TL: Mahirap mag-isip kapag walang laman ang tiyan. Penge namang makakain?

text.EN: I could really use a snack or some canned goods right now.
text.TL: Kailangan ko talaga ng meryenda o de-lata ngayon.

text.EN: Getting weak from hunger. Do you have any rations to share?
text.TL: Nanghihina na ako sa gutom. May maibabahagi ka bang rasyon?
